head: working-tree
subject: gRPC xDS CSDS last_updated timestamps
change: Accepted resources now carry a wall-clock acceptance time. The SotW subscription entry records when its accepted version was committed, and each delta per-resource Version records its own acceptance time through markAccepted after decide. Controller.encodeClientStatus maps that time to GenericXdsConfig.last_updated seconds/nanos; pending resources remain without a timestamp. The CSDS interop gate also decodes the official Timestamp field.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/csds_tests.zig asserts a positive last_updated for every accepted delta resource and for the accepted SotW listener, and no timestamp for the pending CDS subscription.

interop.result: the official csds.proto decode checks the emitted last_updated seconds/nanos and that the exclude_resource_contents response keeps the timestamp

notes: SotW shares one acceptance time across every resource of a response because the whole response is accepted together; delta records each resource's own version acceptance time. Times come from the real clock (std.Io.Timestamp.now(io, .real)) and are process-local, so a controller recreation starts without historical timestamps.
